checks.name: Demo LiDAR geometry on bundled synthetic data
Building and canopy metrics on bundled synthetic data
checks.sql: SELECT feature_id, round(building_p95_m, 1), canopy_max_m FROM lidar.main.height_metrics((SELECT * FROM lidar.main.demo_input())) ORDER BY feature_id

checks.name: Vegetation conductor clearance on bundled synthetic data
checks.sql: SELECT feature_id, round(clearance_m, 2) FROM lidar.main.vegetation_clearance((SELECT * FROM lidar.main.demo_input(kind := 'conductor'))) ORDER BY feature_id, point_index

checks.name: Empty polygon relation
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM lidar.main.height_metrics((SELECT * FROM lidar.main.demo_input() WHERE false))

checks.name: Multiple conductor batches
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), min(clearance_m), max(clearance_m) FROM lidar.main.vegetation_clearance((SELECT i::VARCHAR feature_id, geometry_wkb FROM lidar.main.demo_input(kind := 'conductor') CROSS JOIN range(2501) t(i)))

checks.name: Prioritize vegetation clearance by asset owner
checks.sql:
WITH assets(feature_id, circuit_name) AS (VALUES ('line', 'Circuit 12')),
conflicts AS (SELECT * FROM lidar.main.vegetation_clearance((SELECT * FROM lidar.main.demo_input(kind := 'conductor'))))
SELECT a.circuit_name, count(*) AS vegetation_returns, round(min(c.clearance_m), 2) AS closest_m
FROM conflicts c JOIN assets a USING(feature_id) GROUP BY a.circuit_name ORDER BY a.circuit_name
